MSG_INITIALIZED.doc: Posted to every listener once `init` finishes.

MSG_INITIALIZATION_FAILED.doc: Message id reserved for a failed initialization; this version never posts it.

MSG_FILE_LOADED.doc: Posted with `file_name` and `module_name` each time an archive is mounted.

MSG_MODULE_LOADED.doc: Posted with `file_name` and `module_name` once every archive of a module is mounted.

MSG_ALL_LOADED.doc: Posted once every queued archive is mounted.

MSG_NETWORK_ERROR.doc: Posted when an archive download fails; the download retries after five seconds.

DEBUG.doc: Debug log level passed to the `set_log_function` callback.

INFO.doc: Info log level passed to the `set_log_function` callback.

WARN.doc: Warning log level passed to the `set_log_function` callback.

ERROR.doc: Error log level passed to the `set_log_function` callback.

FATAL.doc: Fatal log level passed to the `set_log_function` callback.

RES_HIGH_ONLY.doc: `res_mode` that loads only the high-resolution archives; the default.

RES_LOW_ONLY.doc: `res_mode` that loads only the low-resolution archives.
